goals.name: Deviation Expedition Session Goal Harness
goals.description: Deviation Expedition Session Goal Harness [deviation-expedition-session] — compiled from capabilities/harnesses/mh-04-deviation-expedition-session.yaml
goals.gate: All gates passed or degraded-with-log; zero unresolved halt gates, zero stop events

gates.name: 0.1 Startup phrase spoken and expedition topic pinned with its b
gates.description: Startup phrase spoken and expedition topic pinned with its baseline corpus declared before any tail is generated
gates.command: Session log line 'TOPIC: <topic> | BASELINE: <n> scores' with n >= 5; baseline values recorded to .rig/expedition/baseline.txt one per line

gates.name: 0.2 Expedition doctrine loaded: the three-tail structure (positi
gates.description: Expedition doctrine loaded: the three-tail structure (positive, negative, repaired) and verifier-only termination are recited; the runner scores but never certifies its own run
gates.command: Session preamble contains the phrases 'positive tail', 'negative tail', 'repaired tail', and 'verifier-only termination'

gates.name: 0.3 RIG coordinate stated before first tail is generated
gates.description: RIG coordinate stated before first tail is generated
gates.command: Session log line of form 'COORD: L2-L4 x D2-D3 x A1-A3 x IQRSQPI'

gates.name: 0.4 Harness tuple H_expedition(topic, three_tails, certified_z,
gates.description: Harness tuple H_expedition(topic, three_tails, certified_z, band_routing, verdict) declared with all five components named
gates.command: Session log contains the tuple declaration verbatim

gates.name: 1.1 MathExec substrate proven live before any scoring: self-test
gates.description: MathExec substrate proven live before any scoring: self-test passes including its two planted failures, establishing the estimator can go red this session
gates.command: python3 ~/Developer/needle-haystack/artifacts/meta/mathexec_substrate.py self-test exits 0 with 'SELF-TEST PASS: 7 checks incl. 2 planted failures' saved to .rig/expedition/mathexec-selftest.txt

gates.name: 1.2 Baseline corpus validated: n >= 5 numeric scores, no all-ide
gates.description: Baseline corpus validated: n >= 5 numeric scores, no all-identical values (MAD=0 trap), provenance of the corpus recorded
gates.command: python3 -c loading .rig/expedition/baseline.txt asserting len >= 5 and len(set) >= 3; provenance line appended; exit 0 recorded

gates.name: 2.1 Positive tail generated: >= 3 candidate artifacts pushed tow
gates.description: Positive tail generated: >= 3 candidate artifacts pushed toward +sigma rungs, each with an engine tag and rung label from the deviation ladder
gates.command: .rig/expedition/tail-positive.md contains >= 3 candidate blocks each tagged 'engine:' and 'rung:'; python3 count assertion exit 0

gates.name: 2.2 Negative tail generated: >= 3 anti-candidates (deliberately
gates.description: Negative tail generated: >= 3 anti-candidates (deliberately median/collapsed) produced as contrast material, each tagged with the failure mode it embodies
gates.command: .rig/expedition/tail-negative.md contains >= 3 blocks each tagged 'failure_mode:'; python3 count assertion exit 0

gates.name: 2.3 Repaired tail generated: every negative-tail anti-candidate
gates.description: Repaired tail generated: every negative-tail anti-candidate is rewritten toward the positive direction with the repair mechanism named; no orphan anti-candidates
gates.command: python3 -c asserting count of 'repair:' blocks in .rig/expedition/tail-repaired.md equals the negative-tail block count; 1:1 mapping table included

gates.name: 3.1 Certified z computed per finalist: every tail finalist is sc
gates.description: Certified z computed per finalist: every tail finalist is scored via the deviation subcommand and certified_z is the conservative minimum across estimators (MAD, Qn, bootstrap, alternate corpus when present)
gates.command: python3 ~/Developer/needle-haystack/artifacts/meta/mathexec_substrate.py deviation --score <s> --baseline <b> per finalist; JSON outputs with 'certified_z' saved to .rig/expedition/zscores/; no z taken from a single estimator

gates.name: 3.2 Adversarial stability for extremes: any finalist with |z| >=
gates.description: Adversarial stability for extremes: any finalist with |z| >= 10 passes the substrate's adversarial pass (leave-one-out, perturbation, estimator swap) before its band is trusted
gates.command: python3 ~/Developer/needle-haystack/artifacts/meta/mathexec_substrate.py adversarial --score <s> --baseline <b> output showing band-stable verdict saved per extreme finalist

gates.name: 3.3 Sigma-band routing executed: every certified finalist is rou
gates.description: Sigma-band routing executed: every certified finalist is routed through the Deviatrix band table (ceiling_breach >= ±30, strong_deviation >= 5, differentiated_ordinary >= 3, etc.) and the routing record {z_cert, band, action, target} is emitted per finalist
gates.command: python3 -c importing sigma_band from the substrate (or replicating its thresholds) applied to each certified_z; routing table saved to .rig/expedition/routing.txt with one record per finalist

gates.name: 3.4 Expedition event recorded: the run is logged to rig-memory-o
gates.description: Expedition event recorded: the run is logged to rig-memory-os with the winner's certified z and band
gates.command: rig-memory-os memory.record_event(kind="expedition_run", topic=<topic>, winner_sigma=<band>, z_certified=<z>, pass=<bool>) returns an event id recalled byte-for-byte; round-trip in .rig/expedition/memory-roundtrip.txt

gates.name: 4.1 Verifier-only termination: the win verdict is issued by a se
gates.description: Verifier-only termination: the win verdict is issued by a separate verifier pass (not the generating pass) that re-runs the winner's certified_z from the raw baseline and confirms the band; runner self-certification is void
gates.command: .rig/expedition/verdict.md names the verifier pass distinctly from the runner; re-computed certified_z matches gate 3.1 output within float tolerance; diff of recomputation saved

gates.name: 4.2 Winner's provenance complete: engine tags, rung ladder, repa
gates.description: Winner's provenance complete: engine tags, rung ladder, repair lineage (if from repaired tail), and all three z-JSON files attached to the verdict
gates.command: verdict.md links existing files under .rig/expedition/; python3 os.path.exists assertion on every linked path; exit 0 recorded

gates.name: 4.3 Engine-combination pattern proposed: the winning engine comb
gates.description: Engine-combination pattern proposed: the winning engine combo is submitted as reusable memory for future expeditions on similar topics
gates.command: rig-memory-os memory.propose_memory(content="engine_combo", evidence_refs=[<expedition_run event id>]) acknowledged; ack id in .rig/expedition/proposal.txt

preconditions.startup_phrase: I am the expedition runner. Three tails, certified z, verifier terminates — I never call my own winner.
preconditions.bms_bias: A2 generation-led during tail exploration; A1 verification-led at certification; A3 permitted for repair-pass drafting; A4 forbidden — expeditions never publish winners outward without Gate-D

self_improvement.update_trigger: the same band flips under adversarial pass 3+ times → the baseline-corpus minimum is raised in this harness; repeated ceiling-breach claims from one topic class are proposed to meta-sigma-band-router as calibration warnings

success_conditions: All gates passed or degraded-with-log; zero unresolved halt gates, zero stop events
Three tails on file with correct counts and 1:1 negative-to-repaired mapping
Every finalist has a certified_z JSON from the deviation subcommand; extremes have adversarial stability proof
Routing table emitted for all certified finalists
Verdict issued by the verifier pass with recomputation evidence; provenance links resolve
expedition_run event recorded and round-trip verified; engine combo proposed
One improvement entry appended to the improvements log
failure_states: notes: No stop gates: a failed expedition certifies nothing and records pass=false. Gate 4.1 failure (verifier disagrees with runner) voids the verdict, not the tails — the tails are retained and the expedition is re-verified with a fresh verifier pass
halt gate(s) 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 3.1, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4, 4.1, 4.2: no progress without gate evidence
degrade gate(s) 4.3: continue with deficit logged in the Definition of Done waiver

Expedition doctrine loaded: the three-tail structure (positive, negative, repaired) and verifier-only termination are recited; the runner scores but never certifies its own run
RIG coordinate stated before first tail is generated
Harness tuple H_expedition(topic, three_tails, certified_z, band_routing, verdict) declared with all five components named
MathExec substrate proven live before any scoring: self-test passes including its two planted failures, establishing the estimator can go red this session
Baseline corpus validated: n >= 5 numeric scores, no all-identical values (MAD=0 trap), provenance of the corpus recorded
Positive tail generated: >= 3 candidate artifacts pushed toward +sigma rungs, each with an engine tag and rung label from the deviation ladder
Negative tail generated: >= 3 anti-candidates (deliberately median/collapsed) produced as contrast material, each tagged with the failure mode it embodies
Repaired tail generated: every negative-tail anti-candidate is rewritten toward the positive direction with the repair mechanism named; no orphan anti-candidates

Certified z computed per finalist: every tail finalist is scored via the deviation subcommand and certified_z is the conservative minimum across estimators (MAD, Qn, bootstrap, alternate corpus when present)
Adversarial stability for extremes: any finalist with |z| >= 10 passes the substrate's adversarial pass (leave-one-out, perturbation, estimator swap) before its band is trusted

Sigma-band routing executed: every certified finalist is routed through the Deviatrix band table (ceiling_breach >= ±30, strong_deviation >= 5, differentiated_ordinary >= 3, etc.) and the routing record {z_cert, band, action, target} is emitted per finalist
Expedition event recorded: the run is logged to rig-memory-os with the winner's certified z and band

final_rule: certified_z is the conservative minimum — never the flattering estimator.
The runner never calls its own winner; the verifier terminates.
Every deviation-expedition session leaves the system stronger than it found it.

prose: notes: No stop gates: a failed expedition certifies nothing and records pass=false. Gate 4.1 failure (verifier disagrees with runner) voids the verdict, not the tails — the tails are retained and the expedition is re-verified with a fresh verifier pass
